case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for explaining the cost structure behind your quote. The increases in alloy and processing costs are real pressures; our analysis nevertheless supports a lower price alongside a longer agreement.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).

A longer agreement would give your account planning more continuity and support a pricing committee review of our proposal. We are flexible on payment terms, including retaining your quoted terms; which option works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.21 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our relationship and appreciate your openness in reviewing the calculation.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We welcome the opportunity to establish a 24-month agreement to support your account planning. For a contract of this duration, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material volatility, as a fixed price is not viable.

Our revised offer stands at a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

As an alternative, retaining our standard 30-day payment terms alongside this index, we can reduce our offer to EUR 5.60 per unit, with a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for reducing your offer and confirming the material share; we recognise that material volatility needs protection in a longer agreement. We have made a modest price concession and adopted your standard payment terms, and we ask for a further price reduction in return.

We are flexible on indexation: Option B includes the alloy index clause you requested, while the longer agreement gives your account planning continuity. This exchanges material-cost protection for a lower price; which option works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.30 per unit, fixed price, no index clause, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.26 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your openness and hope this gives your pricing committee a clear basis for agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your message. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

To help us understand your position better, please share the analysis that supports your target price, as our current cost structure does not permit us to meet it. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

For your transparency, our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. 

As a reminder, our proposal remains a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We value your business and look forward to continuing our discussion to find a good way forward together.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for clarifying your cost drivers and making a further price adjustment. You ask which figures support our target; we recognise your cost pressures, but our target is a commercial proposal tied to the terms offered, not a calculation showing that your input costs have fallen.

We have modestly raised our offer and are flexible on indexation: Option B provides the alloy clause you requested in exchange for a lower price, with the agreement giving your account planning continuity. Which option works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.38 per unit, fixed price, no index clause, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.33 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your openness and look forward to a reciprocal price step that your pricing committee can support.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We appreciate your increased offer, but a fixed price over 24 months is not viable for us. Please note that introducing a deadband to the index clause shifts material risk, which prevents us from lowering the base price. Furthermore, we have already taken that quality record data into account.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. As part of our comprehensive service, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Here is our Angebot: a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
